title: Etale inverse image preserves injective abelian sheaves
statement: For any etale morphism v:W → X of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and any injective abelian sheaf I on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the inverse image v*I [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is injective on W. The coefficients are AddCommGrpCat, not a separately chosen category of module sheaves.

source.place: injective_upperStar_obj_of_etale_addCommGrp, lines 45–74; exact left adjoint to localization restriction

proof.text: Apply the already proved injective_upperStar_obj_of_etale_addCommGrp. Its proof constructs the left adjoint by left Kan extension along the localization functor followed by sheafification. The source theorem SmallSite.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_overMap_of_isGrothendieckAbelian gives left exactness of this Kan extension for abelian groups; inclusion of sheaves and sheafification preserve finite limits. The localization restriction comparison transports the sheaf adjunction to v*. By the exact-left-adjoint criterion, this right adjoint preserves injectives. The declaration is already proved in the source library and contains no sorry.

proof_origin.by: worker S2, attachment of existing proved declaration
